name: Lookup Popup Open Sequence
description: The fixed action sequence every lkup control runs in whenclick to open the shared picker popup. There is ONE popup layout in the whole engine (doctype:"popup", docno:"lookup"); the dslist dataset is how you configure it for a particular entity. Two forms exist: a 2-action simple form, and a 3-action chained form where follow-up work is staged into customevents first.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 2.6 (simple form: Division, Location, Contact, Staff, Payment Mode), 3.6 (grid-row form: Stock Master), 7.2 (chained form: GL code, Supplier, Currency)

listtype.description: Server-side list id, e.g. "FAPOGL". See the listtype table in examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md PART 9.3.

dataset.description: Dataset the picked row writes back into.

filtercondition.description: Restricts the picker's rows, e.g. {"PUR_AC_DOCNO":"[DsFrmHeaderEntry.PUR_AC_DOCNO]"} limits suppliers to the chosen GL account.

rules: EVERY lookup must either stage a customevents list or clear it (data:null) as its first action. Leaving customevents untouched means a previous lookup's staged follow-up fires against the wrong field.
bind the lkup to the _DESC field; the popup writes _DOCTYPE/_DOCNO/_DESC itself via the three *field props.
The third action is byte-identical everywhere — do not parameterise it.

For grid-row lookups, rowindex:"[this.propkey]" goes in the dslist payload, and any staged customevents actions must then read the index back as [dslist.rowindex] (the row context is gone once the popup closes). See molecule.deferred-actions-customevents.
